'''Galall''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was part of the Imperial strike team during the events of the [[Conquest of Makeb]] acting as an armorer for fellow [[Sith Warrior]]s.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Galall first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Rakata Gear vendor for the Sith Warrior class.<ref name="TOR" /> During a restructuring of the game's gear system in Game Update 2.0, he was changed to a Basic Gear vendor. He was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
